title: Awards
description: content/data/awards.json: awards shown in the Awards section and the full CV. Array of entries.

awarder.description: Who gave it. Required by the resume generator.

date.description: When, as text (e.g. "2025", "Fall 2024"). Required by the resume generator; identical title+awarder pairs are merged into one CV line.

link.description: Optional URL; makes the awarder a link.

badge.description: Highlight badge next to the title, e.g. "Best Paper".

spotlight.description: Legacy form of badge: true shows "Spotlight", a string shows that text.

show_on_website.description: Set to false to hide the award on the website.

show_in_resume_short.description: Not read: the short resume has no awards section.
